faq.headline: Answers to common questions.
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our collaboration model, delivery timelines, and engineering standards.

q1.question: What types of projects do you develop?
q1.answer: We develop custom high-performance web applications, bespoke corporate websites, scalable e-commerce storefronts, cross-platform mobile apps, and custom AI-powered automation platforms.

q2.question: How does the development process work?
q2.answer: Our process follows five systematic phases: Discovery, Strategy & Architecture, Interactive Design, Precision Development, and Production Launch. We provide continuous weekly updates and prototype demos.

q3.question: How long does a typical project take?
q3.answer: Landing pages and corporate websites typically take 2 to 4 weeks. Complex SaaS applications, portals, and custom e-commerce platforms range from 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope and integrations.

q4.question: Can you work with an existing codebase or redesign a current website?
q4.answer: Yes. We frequently conduct code and architectural audits to modernize legacy systems, refactor performance bottlenecks, or completely redesign legacy platforms into modern Next.js applications.

q5.question: Do you provide post-launch maintenance and support?
q5.answer: Absolutely. We offer tailored SLA support packages including proactive security monitoring, framework updates, cloud infrastructure scaling, and ongoing feature development.

q6.question: Can I request custom integrations (CRM, payment, AI APIs)?
q6.answer: Yes. We have deep experience integrating third-party APIs including Stripe, PayPal, Salesforce, HubSpot, OpenAI/Anthropic, AWS, and custom enterprise databases.

q7.question: How do I get a quotation for my project?
q7.answer: Fill out our project inquiry form below with your requirements, timeline, and estimated budget. We will review your brief and schedule an introductory technical call within 24 hours.
